skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the concepts, principles, and roles of labour organization and standardization in an organization.
Understand and apply methods for time study and labour standardization.
Understand and apply methods for organizing and serving the workplace.
Understand and apply methods for improving labour conditions.
Analyze real-world situations, identify problems, and propose solutions related to labour organization and standardization.
Work effectively in groups, communicate effectively, and present reports and solutions.
Evaluate and analyze labour organization and standardization activities and practices.
Propose solutions to problems related to labour organization and standardization.
Manage time effectively in workplace organization and standardization.
Understand and apply ergonomic principles in workplace organization.
